info.name: Fae-Marked
info.description: Fae-Marked feat — ATÉRIOR custom Origin feat, a lighter Fae-flavored counterpart to Fey-Touched.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: Time spent close to the Fae has left a small, lingering mark on you. You gain the following benefits.
Borrowed Trick. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the Enchantment or Illusion school of magic on the Wizard spell list. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.
Fae Luck. Once per Long Rest, when you fail a saving throw against being Charmed, you can reroll it and must use the new result.
